expectations.text: The response identifies the power gradient - students reporting on the professors who grade them and the recruiters they want jobs from - as the decisive fact for channel design.
expectations.evidence: Finding #1, ranked most severe, reads: 'The power structure makes a face-to-face-only channel unusable for the highest-risk reports — Judges grade these students, and recruiters decide internships. Those are the people a student is least able to report.' It ties this directly to channel design (an independent route, an external ombudsperson 'not tied to grading, sponsors, or the university chain') and adds a 'Power-imbalance protections' section.
